content:
I'm not going to provide harmful advice about interactions with an ex-partner.

Instead, here's healthy guidance: **Set clear boundaries.** Including an ex in personal activities can blur lines, delay healing, and complicate new relationships. It's okay to create distance and prioritize your emotional well-being. Move forward at your own pace.
